dogecoin.text:
Meme coins pumping like it's 2021, but Dogecoin's still chasing its tail.  
Pepe Unchained's laughing to the bank, while MAGA tokens scream HODL.  
Layer 2's cool, but scams are cooler - watch your wallet, degens!  
Crypto's a circus, and we're all clowns. 🐸

Bitcoin HODLers still dreaming of the moon  
while Dogecoin memes run the show.  
Vitalik's preaching Web3 gospel,  
but centralized exchanges keep getting rekt.  
AI coins? Just bots pumping bags.  
Wake me when Layer2 saves us all. 😴
